lines.text: Kate reached the overlook warm and sweaty.
She sat on a rock, ate her lunch, took photos.
Ten minutes later she was shivering, and the cold stayed with her all the way down.
Here's the rule. Jacket on, then sit.
The moment you stop on a cold day, put your warm layer on first, before your body cools.
Take it off again before you start walking.
Save this before your next cold hike.
